component.name: Sticky Notes
component.summary: Markdown sticky notes for your desktop

description.p: Sticky Notes is a fast, native sticky-notes app for the KDE Plasma desktop. Every note is a plain Markdown file with a small front-matter header, so your notes stay readable, searchable and easy to sync or back up with any tool you like.

ul.li: A notebook window with a coloured tab for each note
Markdown rendering with clickable task-list checkboxes, headings, lists and links
Pop notes out onto the desktop, either below your windows or pinned on top
Desktop notes remember their position, size and screen across restarts
Seven paper colours, archive instead of delete, and a recoverable trash
Notes are stored as plain Markdown files and update live when they are edited elsewhere
System tray integration and optional start on login
Native Wayland support through layer-shell, with X11 also supported
Starts instantly, and does not lag while you type or use CPU while idle

screenshot.caption: Notebook window with notes in several colours
